# PART 1, Statistical Power​ - Q1
```{r}
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(5571)

# Parameters
n <- 10000                 # Sample size per group
p_control <- 0.02          # Control conversion rate
p_exp <- 0.025             # Conversion rate (25% increase)
n_sim <- 1000              # Number of simulations
alpha <- 0.05              # Significance level

# Function to perform a two-proportion z-test
two_prop_test <- function(x1, n1, x2, n2, alpha = 0.05) {
  p1 <- x1 / n1
  p2 <- x2 / n2
  p_pool <- (x1 + x2) / (n1 + n2)
  z <- (p1 - p2) / sqrt(p_pool * (1 - p_pool) * (1/n1 + 1/n2))
  p_value <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))  # Two-sided
  return(p_value < alpha)
}

# Run simulation
results <- replicate(n_sim, {
  x1 <- rbinom(1, n, p_control)
  x2 <- rbinom(1, n, p_exp)
  two_prop_test(x1, n, x2, n, alpha)
})

# Empirical power
empirical_power <- mean(results)
empirical_power
```
# PART 1, Statistical Power​ - Q2
```{r}
# New sample sizes
scenarios <- list(
  "5000 each" = c(15000, 15000),
  "10000 control" = c(20000, 10000),
  "10000 exp" = c(10000, 20000)
)

# Function to simulate power for each scenario
simulate_power <- function(n1, n2, n_sim = 1000) {
  results <- replicate(n_sim, {
    x1 <- rbinom(1, n1, p_control)
    x2 <- rbinom(1, n2, p_exp)
    two_prop_test(x1, n1, x2, n2, alpha)
  })
  return(mean(results))
}

# Compute power for each scenario
sapply(scenarios, function(x) simulate_power(x[1], x[2]))
```
# PART 1, Statistical Power​ - Q3
```{r}
# Range of treatment conversion rates
p_treatment_vals <- seq(0.015, 0.03, by = 0.0025)

# Compute power for each value
power_vals <- sapply(p_exp_vals, function(p_exp) {
  results <- replicate(n_sim, {
    x1 <- rbinom(1, n, p_control)
    x2 <- rbinom(1, n, p_exp)
    two_prop_test(x1, n, x2, n, alpha)
  })
  mean(results)
})

# Plot power curve
plot(p_exp_vals, power_vals, type = "b", pch = 19, col = "blue",
     xlab = "True Ads Conversion Rate",
     ylab = "Empirical Power",
     main = "Power vs True Ads Conversion Rate")
abline(h = 0.8, col = "red", lty = 2)  # Common target power

p_exp_vals
power_vals
```

# PART 2, Linear Regression Assumptions​, Option 1: Normality - Q1​
```{r}
set.seed(19)

n <- 100
x <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n)
n_sim <- 10000

# Storage
beta1_hat_norm <- numeric(n_sim)
se_beta1_hat_norm <- numeric(n_sim)

beta1_hat_chisq <- numeric(n_sim)
se_beta1_hat_chisq <- numeric(n_sim)

for (i in 1:n_sim) {
  # Normal errors
  y_norm <- x + rnorm(n, 0, sd=2)
  mod_norm <- lm(y_norm ~ x)
  beta1_hat_norm[i] <- coef(mod_norm)[2]
  se_beta1_hat_norm[i] <- summary(mod_norm)$coefficients[2,2]
  
  # Chi-squared errors
  y_chisq <- x + (rchisq(n, 2)-2)
  mod_chisq <- lm(y_chisq ~ x)
  beta1_hat_chisq[i] <- coef(mod_chisq)[2]
  se_beta1_hat_chisq[i] <- summary(mod_chisq)$coefficients[2,2]
}

par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(beta1_hat_norm, breaks=50, main="Slope Estimates: Normal Errors",
     xlab=expression(hat(beta)[1]), col="skyblue")
abline(v=1, col="red", lwd=2)

hist(beta1_hat_chisq, breaks=50, main="Slope Estimates: Chi-squared Errors",
     xlab=expression(hat(beta)[1]), col="orange")
abline(v=1, col="red", lwd=2)

```
# PART 2, Linear Regression Assumptions​, Option 1: Normality - Q2
```{r}
sigma <- 2  # true SD for normal errors
se_theoretical <- sigma / sqrt(sum((x - mean(x))^2))
se_theoretical


sd(beta1_hat_norm)
sd(beta1_hat_chisq)


par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(se_beta1_hat_norm, breaks=50, main="Estimated SEs: Normal Errors",
     xlab="SE", col="skyblue")
abline(v=se_theoretical, col="red", lwd=2)

hist(se_beta1_hat_chisq, breaks=50, main="Estimated SEs: Chi-squared Errors",
     xlab="SE", col="orange")
abline(v=mean(se_beta1_hat_chisq), col="red", lwd=2)
```

# PART 2, Linear Regression Assumptions​, Option 1: Normality - Q3
```{r}
# Normal
coverage_norm <- mean((beta1_hat_norm - 1.96*se_beta1_hat_norm <= 1) &
                      (beta1_hat_norm + 1.96*se_beta1_hat_norm >= 1))

# Chi-squared
coverage_chisq <- mean((beta1_hat_chisq - 1.96*se_beta1_hat_chisq <= 1) &
                       (beta1_hat_chisq + 1.96*se_beta1_hat_chisq >= 1))

coverage_norm
coverage_chisq

```
